FORMAT_VERSION.label: Eeprom format version number
FORMAT_VERSION.description: This value is incremented when changes are made to the eeprom format

PILOT_THR_FILT.label: Throttle filter cutoff
PILOT_THR_FILT.description: Throttle filter cutoff (Hz) - active whenever altitude control is inactive - 0 to disable

PILOT_THR_BHV.label: Throttle stick behavior
PILOT_THR_BHV.description: Bitmask containing various throttle stick options. TX with sprung throttle can set PILOT_THR_BHV to "1" so motor feedback when landed starts from mid-stick instead of bottom of stick.

GCS_PID_MASK.label: GCS PID tuning mask
GCS_PID_MASK.description: bitmask of PIDs to send MAVLink PID_TUNING messages for

RTL_CONE_SLOPE.label: RTL cone slope
RTL_CONE_SLOPE.description: Defines a cone above home which determines maximum climb

RTL_LOIT_TIME.label: RTL loiter time
RTL_LOIT_TIME.description: Time (in milliseconds) to loiter above home before beginning final descent

RTL_ALT_TYPE.label: RTL mode altitude type
RTL_ALT_TYPE.description: RTL altitude type.  Set to 1 for Terrain following during RTL and then set WP_RFND_USE=1 to use rangefinder or WP_RFND_USE=0 to use Terrain database

FS_GCS_ENABLE.label: Ground Station Failsafe Enable
FS_GCS_ENABLE.description: Controls whether failsafe will be invoked (and what action to take) when connection with Ground station is lost for at least 5 seconds. See FS_OPTIONS param for additional actions, or for cases allowing Mission continuation, when GCS failsafe is enabled.

enum.2: RTL or Continue with Mission in Auto Mode (Removed in 4.0+-see FS_OPTIONS)

GPS_HDOP_GOOD.label: GPS Hdop Good
GPS_HDOP_GOOD.description: GPS Hdop value at or below this value represent a good position.  Used for pre-arm checks

SUPER_SIMPLE.label: Super Simple Mode
SUPER_SIMPLE.description: Bitmask to enable Super Simple mode for some flight modes. Setting this to Disabled(0) will disable Super Simple Mode. The bitmask is for flight mode switch positions

WP_YAW_BEHAVIOR.label: Yaw behaviour during missions
WP_YAW_BEHAVIOR.description: Determines how the autopilot controls the yaw during missions and RTL

FS_THR_ENABLE.label: Throttle Failsafe Enable
FS_THR_ENABLE.description: The throttle failsafe allows you to configure a software failsafe activated by a setting on the throttle input channel

enum.2: Enabled Continue with Mission in Auto Mode (Removed in 4.0+)

FS_THR_VALUE.label: Throttle Failsafe Value
FS_THR_VALUE.description: The PWM level in microseconds on channel 3 below which throttle failsafe triggers

THR_DZ.label: Throttle deadzone
THR_DZ.description: The deadzone above and below mid throttle in PWM microseconds. Used in AltHold, Loiter, PosHold flight modes

FLTMODE1.label: Flight Mode 1
FLTMODE1.description: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is <= 1230

FLTMODE2.label: Flight Mode 2
FLTMODE2.description: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1230, <= 1360

FLTMODE3.label: Flight Mode 3
FLTMODE3.description: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1360, <= 1490

FLTMODE4.label: Flight Mode 4
FLTMODE4.description: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1490, <= 1620

FLTMODE5.label: Flight Mode 5
FLTMODE5.description: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1620, <= 1749

FLTMODE6.label: Flight Mode 6
FLTMODE6.description: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >=1750

FLTMODE_CH.label: Flightmode channel
FLTMODE_CH.description: RC Channel to use for flight mode control

INITIAL_MODE.label: Initial flight mode
INITIAL_MODE.description: This selects the mode to start in on boot. This is useful for when you want to start in AUTO mode on boot without a receiver.

SIMPLE.label: Simple mode bitmask
SIMPLE.description: Bitmask which holds which flight modes use simple heading mode (eg bit 0 = 1 means Flight Mode 0 uses simple mode). The bitmask is for flightmode switch positions.

LOG_BITMASK.label: Log bitmask
LOG_BITMASK.description: Bitmap of what on-board log types to enable. This value is made up of the sum of each of the log types you want to be saved. It is usually best just to enable all basiclog types by setting this to 65535. Note that if you want to reduce log sizes you should consider using LOG_FILE_RATEMAX instead of disabling logging items with this parameter.

ESC_CALIBRATION.label: ESC Calibration
ESC_CALIBRATION.description: Controls whether ArduCopter will enter ESC calibration on the next restart.  Do not adjust this parameter manually.

enum.1: Start-up in ESC Calibration mode if throttle high
enum.2: Start-up in ESC Calibration mode regardless of throttle

TUNE.label: Tuning Parameter
TUNE.description: Selects parameter (normally a PID gain) that is being tuned with an RC transmitter's knob. The RC input channel used is assigned by setting RCx_OPTION to 219.

FRAME_TYPE.label: Frame Type (+, X, V, etc)
FRAME_TYPE.description: Controls motor mixing for multicopters.  Not used for Tri or Traditional Helicopters.

DISARM_DELAY.label: Disarm delay
DISARM_DELAY.description: Delay before automatic disarm in seconds after landing touchdown detection. A value of zero disables auto disarm. If Emergency Motor stop active, delay time is half this value.

PHLD_BRK_RATE.label: PosHold braking rate
PHLD_BRK_RATE.description: PosHold flight mode's rotation rate during braking in deg/sec

LAND_REPOSITION.label: Land repositioning
LAND_REPOSITION.description: Enables user input during LAND mode, the landing phase of RTL, and auto mode landings.

FS_EKF_ACTION.label: EKF Failsafe Action
FS_EKF_ACTION.description: Controls the action that will be taken when an EKF failsafe is invoked

enum.1: Switch to Land mode if current mode requires position
enum.2: Switch to AltHold mode if current mode requires position
enum.3: Switch to Land mode from all modes

FS_EKF_THRESH.label: EKF failsafe variance threshold
FS_EKF_THRESH.description: Allows setting the maximum acceptable compass, velocity, position and height variances. Used in arming check and EKF failsafe.

FS_CRASH_CHECK.label: Crash check enable
FS_CRASH_CHECK.description: This enables automatic crash checking. When enabled the motors will disarm if a crash is detected.

RC_SPEED.label: ESC Update Speed
RC_SPEED.description: This is the speed in Hertz that your ESCs will receive updates

ACRO_BAL_ROLL.label: Acro Balance Roll
ACRO_BAL_ROLL.description: rate at which roll angle returns to level in acro and sport mode.  A higher value causes the vehicle to return to level faster. For helicopter sets the decay rate of the virtual flybar in the roll axis. A higher value causes faster decay of desired to actual attitude.

ACRO_BAL_PITCH.label: Acro Balance Pitch
ACRO_BAL_PITCH.description: rate at which pitch angle returns to level in acro and sport mode.  A higher value causes the vehicle to return to level faster. For helicopter sets the decay rate of the virtual flybar in the pitch axis. A higher value causes faster decay of desired to actual attitude.

ACRO_TRAINER.label: Acro Trainer
ACRO_TRAINER.description: Type of trainer used in acro mode

THROW_MOT_START.label: Start motors before throwing is detected
THROW_MOT_START.description: Used by Throw mode. Controls whether motors will run at the speed set by MOT_SPIN_MIN or will be stopped when armed and waiting for the throw.

THROW_ALT_MIN.label: Throw mode minimum altitude
THROW_ALT_MIN.description: Minimum altitude above which Throw mode will detect a throw or a drop - 0 to disable the check

THROW_ALT_MAX.label: Throw mode maximum altitude
THROW_ALT_MAX.description: Maximum altitude under which Throw mode will detect a throw or a drop - 0 to disable the check

THROW_ALT_DCSND.label: Throw mode target altitude to descend
THROW_ALT_DCSND.description: Target altitude to descend during a drop, (must be positive). This allows for rapidly clearing surrounding obstacles.

THROW_ALT_ACSND.label: Throw mode target altitude to ascsend
THROW_ALT_ACSND.description: Target altitude to ascend during a throw upwards (must be positive). This allows for rapidly clearing surrounding obstacles.

WP_NAVALT_MIN.label: Waypoint navigation altitude minimum
WP_NAVALT_MIN.description: Altitude in meters above which navigation will begin during auto takeoff

THROW_NEXTMODE.label: Throw mode's follow up mode
THROW_NEXTMODE.description: Vehicle will switch to this mode after the throw is successfully completed.  Default is to stay in throw mode (18)

THROW_TYPE.label: Type of Type
THROW_TYPE.description: Used by Throw mode. Specifies whether Copter is thrown upward or dropped.

DEV_OPTIONS.label: Development options
DEV_OPTIONS.description: Bitmask of developer options. The meanings of the bit fields in this parameter may vary at any time. Developers should check the source code for current meaning

FRAME_CLASS.label: Frame Class
FRAME_CLASS.description: Controls major frame class for multicopter component

TUNE_MIN.label: Tuning minimum
TUNE_MIN.description: Transmitter Tuning minum value. The parameter being tuned will have its value set to this minimum value when the tuning knob is at its lowest position

TUNE_MAX.label: Tuning maximum
TUNE_MAX.description: Transmitter Tuning maximum value. The parameter being tuned will have its value set to this maximum value when the tuning knob is at its highest position

FS_VIBE_ENABLE.label: Vibration Failsafe enable
FS_VIBE_ENABLE.description: This enables the vibration failsafe which will use modified altitude estimation and control during high vibrations

FS_OPTIONS.label: Failsafe options bitmask
FS_OPTIONS.description: Bitmask of additional options for battery, radio, & GCS failsafes. 0 (default) disables all options.

ACRO_OPTIONS.label: Acro mode options
ACRO_OPTIONS.description: A range of options that can be applied to change acro mode behaviour. Air-mode enables ATC_THR_MIX_MAN at all times (air-mode has no effect on helicopters). Rate Loop Only disables the use of angle stabilization and uses angular rate stabilization only.

AUTO_OPTIONS.label: Auto mode options
AUTO_OPTIONS.description: A range of options that can be applied to change auto mode behaviour. Allow Arming allows the copter to be armed in Auto. Allow Takeoff Without Raising Throttle allows takeoff without the pilot having to raise the throttle. Ignore pilot yaw overrides the pilot's yaw stick being used while in auto.

GUID_OPTIONS.label: Guided mode options
GUID_OPTIONS.description: Options that can be applied to change guided mode behaviour

FS_GCS_TIMEOUT.label: GCS failsafe timeout
FS_GCS_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout before triggering the GCS failsafe

RTL_OPTIONS.label: RTL mode options
RTL_OPTIONS.description: Options that can be applied to change RTL mode behaviour

RNGFND_FILT.label: Rangefinder filter
RNGFND_FILT.description: Rangefinder filter to smooth distance.  Set to zero to disable filtering

GUID_TIMEOUT.label: Guided mode timeout
GUID_TIMEOUT.description: Guided mode timeout after which vehicle will stop or return to level if no updates are received from caller. Only applicable during any combination of velocity, acceleration, angle control, and/or angular rate control

SURFTRAK_MODE.label: Surface Tracking Mode
SURFTRAK_MODE.description: set which surface to track in surface tracking

FS_DR_ENABLE.label: DeadReckon Failsafe Action
FS_DR_ENABLE.description: Failsafe action taken immediately as deadreckoning starts. Deadreckoning starts when EKF loses position and velocity source and relies only on wind estimates

FS_DR_TIMEOUT.label: DeadReckon Failsafe Timeout
FS_DR_TIMEOUT.description: DeadReckoning is available for this many seconds after losing position and/or velocity source.  After this timeout elapses the EKF failsafe will trigger in modes requiring a position estimate

ACRO_RP_RATE.label: Acro roll/pitch rate control input time constant
ACRO_RP_RATE.description: Acro roll and pitch rate control input time constant.  Low numbers lead to sharper response, higher numbers to softer response

ACRO_Y_RATE.label: Acro yaw rate control input time constant
ACRO_Y_RATE.description: Acro yaw rate control input time constant.  Low numbers lead to sharper response, higher numbers to softer response

PILOT_Y_RATE.label: Pilot yaw rate control input time constant
PILOT_Y_RATE.description: Pilot yaw rate control input time constant.  Low numbers lead to sharper response, higher numbers to softer response

TKOFF_SLEW_TIME.label: Slew time of throttle during take-off
TKOFF_SLEW_TIME.description: Time to slew the throttle from minimum to maximum while checking for a successful takeoff.

TKOFF_RPM_MIN.label: Takeoff Check RPM minimum
TKOFF_RPM_MIN.description: Takeoff is not permitted until motors report at least this RPM.  Set to zero to disable check

PLDP_THRESH.label: Payload Place thrust ratio threshold
PLDP_THRESH.description: Ratio of vertical thrust during decent below which payload touchdown will trigger.

PLDP_RNG_MAX.label: Payload Place maximum range finder altitude
PLDP_RNG_MAX.description: Maximum range finder altitude in m to trigger payload touchdown, set to zero to disable.

PLDP_DELAY.label: Payload Place climb delay
PLDP_DELAY.description: Delay after release, in seconds, before aircraft starts to climb back to starting altitude.

PLDP_SPEED_DN.label: Payload Place decent speed
PLDP_SPEED_DN.description: The maximum vertical decent velocity in m/s. If 0 LAND_SPD_MS value is used.

SURFTRAK_TC.label: Surface Tracking Filter Time Constant
SURFTRAK_TC.description: Time to achieve 63.2% of the surface altitude measurement change.  If 0 filtering is disabled

TKOFF_THR_MAX.label: Takeoff maximum throttle during take-off ramp up
TKOFF_THR_MAX.description: Takeoff maximum throttle allowed before controllers assume the aircraft is airborne during the takeoff process.

TKOFF_RPM_MAX.label: Takeoff Check RPM maximum
TKOFF_RPM_MAX.description: Takeoff is not permitted until motors report no more than this RPM.  Set to zero to disable check

FS_EKF_FILT.label: EKF Failsafe filter cutoff
FS_EKF_FILT.description: EKF Failsafe filter cutoff frequency. EKF variances are filtered using this value to avoid spurious failsafes from transient high variances. A higher value means the failsafe is more likely to trigger.

FSTRATE_ENABLE.label: Enable the fast Rate thread
FSTRATE_ENABLE.description: Enable the fast Rate thread. In the default case the fast rate divisor, which controls the update frequency of the thread, is dynamically scaled from FSTRATE_DIV to avoid overrun in the gyro sample buffer and main loop slow-downs. Other values can be selected to fix the divisor to FSTRATE_DIV on arming or always.

FSTRATE_DIV.label: Fast rate thread divisor
FSTRATE_DIV.description: Fast rate thread divisor used to control the maximum fast rate update rate. The actual rate is the gyro rate in Hz divided by this value. This value is scaled depending on the configuration of FSTRATE_ENABLE.

TUNE2_MIN.label: Tuning minimum
TUNE2_MIN.description: Minimum value that the parameter currently being tuned with the transmitter's TRANSMITTER_TUNING2 knob will be set to

TUNE2_MAX.label: Tuning maximum
TUNE2_MAX.description: Maximum value that the parameter currently being tuned with the transmitter's TRANSMITTER2_TUNING knob will be set to

TUNE2.label: Tuning Parameter for TRANSMITTER_TUNE2
TUNE2.description: Selects parameter (normally a PID gain) that is being tuned with an RC transmitter's knob. The RC input channel used is assigned by setting RCx_OPTION to 220.

PILOT_ACC_Z.label: Pilot vertical acceleration
PILOT_ACC_Z.description: The vertical acceleration used when pilot is controlling the altitude

PILOT_SPD_UP.label: Pilot maximum vertical speed ascending
PILOT_SPD_UP.description: The maximum vertical ascending velocity the pilot may request in m/s

PILOT_SPD_DN.label: Pilot maximum vertical speed descending
PILOT_SPD_DN.description: The maximum vertical descending velocity the pilot may request in m/s.  If 0 PILOT_SPD_UP value is used.

PILOT_TKO_ALT_M.label: Pilot takeoff altitude
PILOT_TKO_ALT_M.description: Altitude that altitude control modes will climb to when a takeoff is triggered with the throttle stick.

AHRS_GPS_GAIN.label: AHRS GPS gain
AHRS_GPS_GAIN.description: This controls how much to use the GPS to correct the attitude. This should never be set to zero for a plane as it would result in the plane losing control in turns. For a plane please use the default value of 1.0.

AHRS_GPS_USE.label: AHRS use GPS for DCM navigation and position-down
AHRS_GPS_USE.description: This controls whether to use dead-reckoning or GPS based navigation. If set to 0 then the GPS won't be used for navigation, and only dead reckoning will be used. A value of zero should never be used for normal flight. Currently this affects only the DCM-based AHRS: the EKF uses GPS according to its own parameters. A value of 2 means to use GPS for height as well as position - both in DCM estimation and when determining altitude-above-home.

enum.2: Use GPS for DCM position and height

AHRS_YAW_P.label: Yaw P
AHRS_YAW_P.description: This controls the weight the compass or GPS has on the heading. A higher value means the heading will track the yaw source (GPS or compass) more rapidly.

AHRS_RP_P.label: AHRS RP_P
AHRS_RP_P.description: This controls how fast the accelerometers correct the attitude

AHRS_WIND_MAX.label: Maximum wind
AHRS_WIND_MAX.description: This sets the maximum allowable difference between ground speed and airspeed. A value of zero means to use the airspeed as is. This allows the plane to cope with a failing airspeed sensor by clipping it to groundspeed plus/minus this limit. See ARSPD_OPTIONS and ARSPD_WIND_MAX to disable airspeed sensors.

AHRS_ORIENTATION.label: Board Orientation
AHRS_ORIENTATION.description: Overall board orientation relative to the standard orientation for the board type. This rotates the IMU and compass readings to allow the board to be oriented in your vehicle at any 90 or 45 degree angle. The label for each option is specified in the order of rotations for that orientation. This option takes affect on next boot. After changing you will need to re-level your vehicle. Firmware versions 4.2 and prior can use a CUSTOM (100) rotation to set the AHRS_CUSTOM_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles for AHRS orientation. Later versions provide two general custom rotations which can be used, Custom 1 and Custom 2, with CUST_ROT1_ROLL/PIT/YAW or CUST_ROT2_ROLL/PIT/YAW angles.

AHRS_COMP_BETA.label: AHRS Velocity Complementary Filter Beta Coefficient
AHRS_COMP_BETA.description: This controls the time constant for the cross-over frequency used to fuse AHRS (airspeed and heading) and GPS data to estimate ground velocity. Time constant is 0.1/beta. A larger time constant will use GPS data less and a small time constant will use air data less.

AHRS_GPS_MINSATS.label: AHRS GPS Minimum satellites
AHRS_GPS_MINSATS.description: Minimum number of satellites visible to use GPS for velocity based corrections attitude correction. This defaults to 6, which is about the point at which the velocity numbers from a GPS become too unreliable for accurate correction of the accelerometers.

AHRS_EKF_TYPE.label: Use NavEKF Kalman filter for attitude and position estimation
AHRS_EKF_TYPE.description: This controls which NavEKF Kalman filter version is used for attitude and position estimation

AHRS_CUSTOM_ROLL.label: Optional AHRS behaviour
AHRS_CUSTOM_ROLL.description: This controls optional AHRS behaviour. Setting DisableDCMFallbackFW will change the AHRS behaviour for fixed wing aircraft in fly-forward flight to not fall back to DCM when the EKF stops navigating. Setting DisableDCMFallbackVTOL will change the AHRS behaviour for fixed wing aircraft in non fly-forward (VTOL) flight to not fall back to DCM when the EKF stops navigating. Setting DontDisableAirspeedUsingEKF disables the EKF based innovation check for airspeed consistency. Setting AutoRecordOrigin will auto-save the EKF origin to parameters when it becomes valid.

AHRS_ORIGIN_LAT.label: AHRS last origin latitude
AHRS_ORIGIN_LAT.description: AHRS last origin latitude in degrees

AHRS_ORIGIN_LON.label: AHRS last origin longitude
AHRS_ORIGIN_LON.description: AHRS last origin longitude in degrees

AHRS_ORIGIN_ALT.label: AHRS last origin altitude
AHRS_ORIGIN_ALT.description: AHRS last origin altitude in meters

INS_GYROFFS_X.label: Gyro offsets of Z axis
INS_GYROFFS_X.description: Gyro sensor offsets of Z axis. This is setup on each boot during gyro calibrations

INS_GYR2OFFS_X.label: Gyro2 offsets of Z axis
INS_GYR2OFFS_X.description: Gyro2 sensor offsets of Z axis. This is setup on each boot during gyro calibrations

INS_GYR3OFFS_X.label: Gyro3 offsets of Z axis
INS_GYR3OFFS_X.description: Gyro3 sensor offsets of Z axis. This is setup on each boot during gyro calibrations

INS_ACCSCAL_X.label: Accelerometer scaling of Z axis
INS_ACCSCAL_X.description: Accelerometer scaling of Z axis  Calculated during acceleration calibration routine

INS_ACCOFFS_X.label: Accelerometer offsets of Z axis
INS_ACCOFFS_X.description: Accelerometer offsets of Z axis. This is setup using the acceleration calibration or level operations

INS_ACC2SCAL_X.label: Accelerometer2 scaling of Z axis
INS_ACC2SCAL_X.description: Accelerometer2 scaling of Z axis  Calculated during acceleration calibration routine

INS_ACC2OFFS_X.label: Accelerometer2 offsets of Z axis
INS_ACC2OFFS_X.description: Accelerometer2 offsets of Z axis. This is setup using the acceleration calibration or level operations

INS_ACC3SCAL_X.label: Accelerometer3 scaling of Z axis
INS_ACC3SCAL_X.description: Accelerometer3 scaling of Z axis  Calculated during acceleration calibration routine

INS_ACC3OFFS_X.label: Accelerometer3 offsets of Z axis
INS_ACC3OFFS_X.description: Accelerometer3 offsets of Z axis. This is setup using the acceleration calibration or level operations

INS_GYRO_FILTER.label: Gyro filter cutoff frequency
INS_GYRO_FILTER.description: Filter cutoff frequency for gyroscopes. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)

INS_ACCEL_FILTER.label: Accel filter cutoff frequency
INS_ACCEL_FILTER.description: Filter cutoff frequency for accelerometers. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)

INS_USE.label: Use first IMU for attitude, velocity and position estimates
INS_USE.description: Use first IMU for attitude, velocity and position estimates

INS_USE2.label: Use second IMU for attitude, velocity and position estimates
INS_USE2.description: Use second IMU for attitude, velocity and position estimates

INS_USE3.label: Use third IMU for attitude, velocity and position estimates
INS_USE3.description: Use third IMU for attitude, velocity and position estimates

INS_STILL_THRESH.label: Stillness threshold for detecting if we are moving
INS_STILL_THRESH.description: Threshold to tolerate vibration to determine if vehicle is motionless. This depends on the frame type and if there is a constant vibration due to motors before launch or after landing. Total motionless is about 0.05. Suggested values: Planes/rover use 0.1, multirotors use 1, tradHeli uses 5

INS_GYR_CAL.label: Gyro Calibration scheme
INS_GYR_CAL.description: Conrols when automatic gyro calibration is performed

INS_TRIM_OPTION.label: Accel cal trim option
INS_TRIM_OPTION.description: Specifies how the accel cal routine determines the trims

enum.2: Assume ACC_BODYFIX is perfectly aligned to the vehicle

INS_ACC_BODYFIX.label: Body-fixed accelerometer
INS_ACC_BODYFIX.description: The body-fixed accelerometer to be used for trim calculation

INS_POS1_X.label: IMU accelerometer Z position
INS_POS1_X.description: Z position of the first IMU accelerometer in body frame. Positive Z is down from the origin. Attention: The IMU should be located as close to the vehicle c.g. as practical so that the value of this parameter is minimised. Failure to do so can result in noisy navigation velocity measurements due to vibration and IMU gyro noise. If the IMU cannot be moved and velocity noise is a problem, a location closer to the IMU can be used as the body frame origin.

INS_POS2_X.label: IMU accelerometer Z position
INS_POS2_X.description: Z position of the second IMU accelerometer in body frame. Positive Z is down from the origin. Attention: The IMU should be located as close to the vehicle c.g. as practical so that the value of this parameter is minimised. Failure to do so can result in noisy navigation velocity measurements due to vibration and IMU gyro noise. If the IMU cannot be moved and velocity noise is a problem, a location closer to the IMU can be used as the body frame origin.

INS_POS3_X.label: IMU accelerometer Z position
INS_POS3_X.description: Z position of the third IMU accelerometer in body frame. Positive Z is down from the origin. Attention: The IMU should be located as close to the vehicle c.g. as practical so that the value of this parameter is minimised. Failure to do so can result in noisy navigation velocity measurements due to vibration and IMU gyro noise. If the IMU cannot be moved and velocity noise is a problem, a location closer to the IMU can be used as the body frame origin.

INS_GYR_ID.label: Gyro ID
INS_GYR_ID.description: Gyro sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

INS_GYR2_ID.label: Gyro2 ID
INS_GYR2_ID.description: Gyro2 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

INS_GYR3_ID.label: Gyro3 ID
INS_GYR3_ID.description: Gyro3 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

INS_ACC_ID.label: Accelerometer ID
INS_ACC_ID.description: Accelerometer sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

INS_ACC2_ID.label: Accelerometer2 ID
INS_ACC2_ID.description: Accelerometer2 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

INS_ACC3_ID.label: Accelerometer3 ID
INS_ACC3_ID.description: Accelerometer3 sensor ID, taking into account its type, bus and instance

INS_FAST_SAMPLE.label: Fast sampling mask
INS_FAST_SAMPLE.description: Mask of IMUs to enable fast sampling on, if available

INS_ENABLE_MASK.label: IMU enable mask
INS_ENABLE_MASK.description: Bitmask of IMUs to enable. It can be used to prevent startup of specific detected IMUs

INS_GYRO_RATE.label: Gyro rate for IMUs with Fast Sampling enabled
INS_GYRO_RATE.description: Gyro rate for IMUs with fast sampling enabled. The gyro rate is the sample rate at which the IMU filters operate and needs to be at least double the maximum filter frequency. If the sensor does not support the selected rate the next highest supported rate will be used. For IMUs which do not support fast sampling this setting is ignored and the default gyro rate of 1Khz is used.

INS_ACC1_CALTEMP.label: Calibration temperature for 1st accelerometer
INS_ACC1_CALTEMP.description: Temperature that the 1st accelerometer was calibrated at

INS_GYR1_CALTEMP.label: Calibration temperature for 1st gyroscope
INS_GYR1_CALTEMP.description: Temperature that the 1st gyroscope was calibrated at

INS_ACC2_CALTEMP.label: Calibration temperature for 2nd accelerometer
INS_ACC2_CALTEMP.description: Temperature that the 2nd accelerometer was calibrated at

INS_GYR2_CALTEMP.label: Calibration temperature for 2nd gyroscope
INS_GYR2_CALTEMP.description: Temperature that the 2nd gyroscope was calibrated at

INS_ACC3_CALTEMP.label: Calibration temperature for 3rd accelerometer
INS_ACC3_CALTEMP.description: Temperature that the 3rd accelerometer was calibrated at

INS_GYR3_CALTEMP.label: Calibration temperature for 3rd gyroscope
INS_GYR3_CALTEMP.description: Temperature that the 3rd gyroscope was calibrated at

INS_TCAL_OPTIONS.label: Options for temperature calibration
INS_TCAL_OPTIONS.description: This enables optional temperature calibration features. Setting of the Persist bits will save the temperature and/or accelerometer calibration parameters in the bootloader sector on the next update of the bootloader.

BATT_VOLT_PIN.label: Battery Voltage sensing pin
BATT_VOLT_PIN.description: Sets the analog input pin that should be used for voltage monitoring.

BATT_CURR_PIN.label: Battery Current sensing pin
BATT_CURR_PIN.description: Sets the analog input pin that should be used for current monitoring.

BATT_VOLT_MULT.label: Voltage Multiplier
BATT_VOLT_MULT.description: Used to convert the voltage of the voltage sensing pin (@PREFIX@VOLT_PIN) to the actual battery's voltage (pin_voltage * VOLT_MULT). For the 3DR Power brick with a Pixhawk, this should be set to 10.1. For the Pixhawk with the 3DR 4in1 ESC this should be 12.02. For the PX using the PX4IO power supply this should be set to 1.

BATT_AMP_PERVLT.label: Amps per volt
BATT_AMP_PERVLT.description: Number of amps that a 1V reading on the current sensor corresponds to. With a Pixhawk using the 3DR Power brick this should be set to 17. For the Pixhawk with the 3DR 4in1 ESC this should be 17. For Synthetic Current sensor monitors, this is the maximum, full throttle current draw.

BATT_AMP_OFFSET.label: AMP offset
BATT_AMP_OFFSET.description: Voltage offset at zero current on current sensor for Analog Sensors. For Synthetic Current sensor, this offset is the zero throttle system current and is added to the calculated throttle base current.

BATT_VLT_OFFSET.label: Voltage offset
BATT_VLT_OFFSET.description: Voltage offset on voltage pin. This allows for an offset due to a diode. This voltage is subtracted before the scaling is applied.

GPS_AUTO_SWITCH.label: Automatic Switchover Setting
GPS_AUTO_SWITCH.description: Automatic switchover to GPS reporting best lock, 1:UseBest selects the GPS with highest status, if both are equal the GPS with highest satellite count is used 4:Use primary if 3D fix or better, will revert to 'UseBest' behaviour if 3D fix is lost on primary

enum.4: Use primary if 3D fix or better

GPS_SBAS_MODE.label: SBAS Mode
GPS_SBAS_MODE.description: This sets the SBAS (satellite based augmentation system) mode if available on this GPS. If set to 2 then the SBAS mode is not changed in the GPS. Otherwise the GPS will be reconfigured to enable/disable SBAS. Disabling SBAS may be worthwhile in some parts of the world where an SBAS signal is available but the baseline is too long to be useful.

GPS_MIN_ELEV.label: Minimum elevation
GPS_MIN_ELEV.description: This sets the minimum elevation of satellites above the horizon for them to be used for navigation. Setting this to -100 leaves the minimum elevation set to the GPS modules default.

GPS_INJECT_TO.label: Destination for GPS_INJECT_DATA MAVLink packets
GPS_INJECT_TO.description: The GGS can send raw serial packets to inject data to multiple GPSes.

GPS_SBP_LOGMASK.label: Swift Binary Protocol Logging Mask
GPS_SBP_LOGMASK.description: Masked with the SBP msg_type field to determine whether SBR1/SBR2 data is logged

GPS_RAW_DATA.label: Raw data logging
GPS_RAW_DATA.description: Handles logging raw data; on uBlox chips that support raw data this will log RXM messages into logger; on Septentrio this will log on the equipment's SD card and when set to 2, the autopilot will try to stop logging after disarming and restart after arming

enum.5: Only log every five samples (uBlox only)

GPS_SAVE_CFG.label: Save GPS configuration
GPS_SAVE_CFG.description: Determines whether the configuration for this GPS should be written to non-volatile memory on the GPS. Currently working for UBlox 6 series and above.

GPS_AUTO_CONFIG.label: Automatic GPS configuration
GPS_AUTO_CONFIG.description: Controls if the autopilot should automatically configure the GPS based on the parameters and default settings

enum.1: Enable automatic configuration for Serial GPSes only
enum.2: Enable automatic configuration for DroneCAN as well
enum.3: Clear all configurations not set by ardupilot (UBlox only)

GPS_BLEND_MASK.label: Multi GPS Blending Mask
GPS_BLEND_MASK.description: Determines which of the accuracy measures Horizontal position, Vertical Position and Speed are used to calculate the weighting on each GPS receiver when soft switching has been selected by setting GPS_AUTO_SWITCH to 2(Blend)

GPS_BLEND_TC.label: Blending time constant
GPS_BLEND_TC.description: Controls the slowest time constant applied to the calculation of GPS position and height offsets used to adjust different GPS receivers for steady state position differences.

GPS_PRIMARY.label: Primary GPS
GPS_PRIMARY.description: This GPS will be used when GPS_AUTO_SWITCH is 0 and used preferentially with GPS_AUTO_SWITCH = 4.

GPS_TYPE.label: GPS Node ID 2
GPS_TYPE.description: GPS Node id for second-discovered GPS.Renamed in 4.6 and later to GPS2_CAN_NODEID.

FENCE_ENABLE.label: Fence enable/disable
FENCE_ENABLE.description: Allows you to enable (1) or disable (0) the fence functionality. Fences can still be enabled and disabled via mavlink or an RC option, but these changes are not persisted.

FENCE_TYPE.label: Fence Type
FENCE_TYPE.description: Configured fence types held as bitmask. Max altitide, Circle and Polygon fences will be immediately enabled if configured. Min altitude fence will only be enabled once the minimum altitude is reached.

FENCE_ACTION.label: Fence Action
FENCE_ACTION.description: What action should be taken when fence is breached

FENCE_ALT_MAX.label: Fence Maximum Altitude
FENCE_ALT_MAX.description: Maximum altitude allowed before geofence triggers. See FENCE_ALT_MAX_TP for reference frame.

FENCE_RADIUS.label: Circular Fence Radius
FENCE_RADIUS.description: Circle fence radius which when breached will cause an RTL

FENCE_MARGIN.label: Fence Margin
FENCE_MARGIN.description: Distance that autopilot's should maintain from the fence to avoid a breach

FENCE_TOTAL.label: Fence polygon point total
FENCE_TOTAL.description: Number of polygon points saved in eeprom (do not update manually)

FENCE_ALT_MIN.label: Fence Minimum Altitude
FENCE_ALT_MIN.description: Minimum altitude allowed before geofence triggers. See FENCE_ALT_MIN_TP for reference frame.

FENCE_RET_RALLY.label: Fence Return to Rally
FENCE_RET_RALLY.description: Should the vehicle return to fence return point or rally point

FENCE_RET_ALT.label: Fence Return Altitude
FENCE_RET_ALT.description: Altitude the vehicle will transit to when a fence breach occurs

FENCE_AUTOENABLE.label: Fence Auto-Enable
FENCE_AUTOENABLE.description: Auto-enable of fences. AutoEnableOnTakeoff enables all configured fences, except the minimum altitude fence (which is enabled when the minimum altitude is reached), after autotakeoffs reach altitude. During autolandings the fences will be disabled.  AutoEnableDisableFloorOnLanding enables all configured fences, except the minimum altitude fence (which is enabled when the minimum altitude is reached), after autotakeoffs reach altitude. During autolandings only the Minimum Altitude fence will be disabled. AutoEnableOnlyWhenArmed enables all configured fences on arming, except the minimum altitude fence (which is enabled when the minimum altitude is reached), but no fences are disabled during autolandings. However, fence breaches are ignored while executing prior breach recovery actions which may include autolandings.

FENCE_OPTIONS.label: Fence options
FENCE_OPTIONS.description: When bit 0 is set disable mode change following fence action until fence breach is cleared. When bit 1 is set the allowable flight areas is the union of all polygon and circle fence areas instead of the intersection, which means a fence breach occurs only if you are outside all of the fence areas.

FENCE_NTF_FREQ.label: Fence margin notification frequency in hz
FENCE_NTF_FREQ.description: When bit 2 of FENCE_OPTIONS is set this parameter controls the frequency of margin breach notifications. If set to 0 only new margin breaches are notified.

FENCE_MARGIN_XY.label: Fence Horizontal Margin
FENCE_MARGIN_XY.description: Distance that autopilot's should maintain from the fence in the horizontal plane to avoid a breach. If set to 0 then FENCE_MARGIN is used.

FENCE_ALT_MAX_TP.label: Altitude max frame type
FENCE_ALT_MAX_TP.description: The altitude reference frame for the maximum altitude fence. Can be AMSL, home-relative, origin relative or AGL.

FENCE_ALT_MIN_TP.label: Altitude min frame type
FENCE_ALT_MIN_TP.description: The altitude reference frame for the minimum altitude fence. Can be AMSL, home-relative, origin relative or AGL.

RC1_MIN.label: RC min PWM
RC1_MIN.description: RC minimum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

RC1_TRIM.label: RC trim PWM
RC1_TRIM.description: RC trim (neutral) PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

RC1_MAX.label: RC max PWM
RC1_MAX.description: RC maximum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

RC1_REVERSED.label: RC reversed
RC1_REVERSED.description: Reverse channel input. Set to 0 for normal operation. Set to 1 to reverse this input channel.

RC1_DZ.label: RC dead-zone
RC1_DZ.description: PWM dead zone in microseconds around trim or bottom

RC1_OPTION.label: RC input option
RC1_OPTION.description: Function assigned to this RC channel

SERVO1_MIN.label: Minimum PWM
SERVO1_MIN.description: minimum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

SERVO1_MAX.label: Maximum PWM
SERVO1_MAX.description: maximum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

SERVO1_TRIM.label: Trim PWM
SERVO1_TRIM.description: Trim PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.

SERVO1_REVERSED.label: Servo reverse
SERVO1_REVERSED.description: Reverse servo operation. Set to 0 for normal operation. Set to 1 to reverse this output channel.

SERVO1_FUNCTION.label: Servo output function
SERVO1_FUNCTION.description: Function assigned to this servo. Setting this to Disabled(0) will setup this output for control by auto missions or MAVLink servo set commands. any other value will enable the corresponding function

ATC_RATE_FF_ENAB.label: Rate Feedforward Enable
ATC_RATE_FF_ENAB.description: Controls whether body-frame rate feedforward is enabled or disabled

ATC_ANGLE_BOOST.label: Angle Boost
ATC_ANGLE_BOOST.description: Angle Boost increases output throttle as the vehicle leans to reduce loss of altitude

ATC_ANG_RLL_P.label: Roll axis angle controller P gain
ATC_ANG_RLL_P.description: Roll axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired roll angle and actual angle to a desired roll rate

ATC_ANG_PIT_P.label: Pitch axis angle controller P gain
ATC_ANG_PIT_P.description: Pitch axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired pitch angle and actual angle to a desired pitch rate

ATC_ANG_YAW_P.label: Yaw axis angle controller P gain
ATC_ANG_YAW_P.description: Yaw axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired yaw angle and actual angle to a desired yaw rate

ATC_ANG_LIM_TC.label: Angle Limit (to maintain altitude) Time Constant
ATC_ANG_LIM_TC.description: Angle Limit (to maintain altitude) Time Constant

ATC_RATE_R_MAX.label: Angular Velocity Max for Roll
ATC_RATE_R_MAX.description: Maximum angular velocity in roll axis

ATC_RATE_P_MAX.label: Angular Velocity Max for Pitch
ATC_RATE_P_MAX.description: Maximum angular velocity in pitch axis

ATC_RATE_Y_MAX.label: Angular Velocity Max for Yaw
ATC_RATE_Y_MAX.description: Maximum angular velocity in yaw axis

ATC_INPUT_TC.label: Attitude control input time constant
ATC_INPUT_TC.description: Attitude control input time constant.  Low numbers lead to sharper response, higher numbers to softer response

ATC_LAND_R_MULT.label: Landed roll gain multiplier
ATC_LAND_R_MULT.description: Roll gain multiplier active when landed. A factor of 1.0 means no reduction in gain while landed. Reduce this factor to reduce ground oscitation in the roll axis.

ATC_LAND_P_MULT.label: Landed pitch gain multiplier
ATC_LAND_P_MULT.description: Pitch gain multiplier active when landed. A factor of 1.0 means no reduction in gain while landed. Reduce this factor to reduce ground oscitation in the pitch axis.

ATC_LAND_Y_MULT.label: Landed yaw gain multiplier
ATC_LAND_Y_MULT.description: Yaw gain multiplier active when landed. A factor of 1.0 means no reduction in gain while landed. Reduce this factor to reduce ground oscitation in the yaw axis.

ATC_ANGLE_MAX.label: Angle Max
ATC_ANGLE_MAX.description: Maximum lean angle in all flight modes

ATC_RATE_WPY_MAX.label: Yaw target slew rate
ATC_RATE_WPY_MAX.description: Maximum rate the yaw target can be updated in Auto, Guided, Circle, Follow, RTL, SmartRTL, Throw and ZigZag flight modes
